_instructions: Copy to P1.json, P2.json ... and fill in during the session. Files beginning with _ are ignored by the summariser. NO names, NO street addresses, NO landlord names, NO contact details - this repository is public. Leave a field null rather than guessing; null is handled, a made-up number is not.

search._hours_spent: A3. Total hours across the whole search.
search._sources_used: A2. e.g. ["yale off-campus site", "facebook group", "friend already here"]

surprises._costs_discovered_after_moving_in: A7. THE KEY LIST. One object per cost: {"label": "heating", "monthly_usd": 180, "note": "January was far worse"}
surprises._gap_months_paid: A8. Months of rent paid before actually arriving.
surprises._would_choose_differently: A10. true / false / null, plus why in the note below.

their_actual_first_year._total_usd: A9. Their own total for twelve months, everything in.
their_actual_first_year._confidence: their words: "pretty sure" / "rough guess" / "I checked my bank"
their_actual_first_year._basis: recalled | partly checked | checked against records

app_said._listing_used: their own ad | their screenshot | closest match from snapshot
app_said._corrections: Demo step 4. Lines the participant said were wrong: [{"line": "laundry", "app_said_usd": 35, "they_say_usd": 0, "why": "in-unit, ad didn't say"}]

reaction._quote: Only if consented_to_anonymous_quote is true. Must be something they would be comfortable seeing in public.

_researcher_note: One sentence: what surprised YOU in this session.
